name: pie
description: A pie chart is a circular statistical chart that represents data as sectors of a whole circle, used to show the proportional relationship of each category to the total. The angle of each sector is proportional to the value it represents, and the entire pie chart represents the sum of the data. Pie charts are particularly suitable for showing the proportional relationship of categorical data and can intuitively display the relative importance of each part to the whole. By using different colored sectors to distinguish between categories, comparing the proportions of each category becomes simple and intuitive. When there are few categories (usually no more than 5-7) and the relationship of each part to the whole needs to be emphasized, a pie chart is a good choice. For cases with many categories, consider merging categories with small proportions into an 'other' category.

data.description: Data for pie chart, it should be an array of objects, each object contains a `category` field and a `value` field, such as, [{ category: '分类一', value: 27 }].

innerRadius.description: Set the innerRadius of pie chart, the value between 0 and 1. Set the pie chart as a donut chart. Set the value to 0.6 or number in [0 ,1] to enable it.

style.description: Style configuration for the chart with a JSON object, optional.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the chart, such as, '#fff'.

palette.description: Color palette for the chart, it is a collection of colors.

texture.description: Set the texture for the chart, optional, default is 'default'. 'rough' refers to hand-drawn style.

theme.description: Set the theme for the chart, optional, default is 'default'.

width.description: Set the width of chart, default is 600.

height.description: Set the height of chart, default is 400.
